metadata.description: Context engineering and harness engineering skills plus a file-based autonomous research-to-skill operating system with measured router-benchmark results across four frontier models

plugins.name: context-engineering
plugins.description: Comprehensive context engineering and harness engineering skills for production-grade AI agent systems: fundamentals, degradation patterns, compression, optimization, multi-agent coordination, memory systems, tool design, filesystem context, hosted agents, evaluation, autonomous harnesses, latent briefing (KV cache sharing between agents), project development, and cognitive architecture. Ships with a researcher operating system (rubrics, mechanism registry, claim provenance, run state machine, adversarial benchmarks, continuous loop).

plugins.name: atomic-agents
plugins.description: Framework-specific skill for building modular, type-safe AI agents with the atomic-agents Python library, covering BaseAgent, BaseIOSchema, system prompt context providers, multi-provider setup, memory management, tool integration, and agent composition patterns

plugins.name: ai-delivery-methodology
plugins.description: Skills for teams delivering AI agent systems through the full agile delivery lifecycle: adapted phase-gate process with AI-specific artefacts (Data Availability Matrix, Evaluation Rubric, HITL Map, Prompt Version History), production observability (metrics, drift detection, prompt versioning), and human-AI collaboration design (automation spectrum, HITL Map, trust calibration, oversight fatigue).
